instructions.localSetup:
1. Extract ZIP
2. Run: npm install (or pnpm install)
3. Copy .env.example to .env and fill API keys
4. Run: npm run dev
5. Open: http://localhost:3000
instructions.pwaInstall:
1. Open app in browser
2. Click 'Installa App' button
3. Confirm installation
4. App will appear on home screen
instructions.deployment:
1. Push code to GitHub
2. Deploy to Render/Vercel
3. Set environment variables
4. Enable PWA in production
instructions.mediaUsage:
All media files are in client/public/manus-storage/
Update image paths in code if needed:
- server/routers.ts: TEXTURES array
- client/src/pages/Home.tsx: Image URLs
- client/src/pages/InspirazioneDCPage.tsx: Gallery images
